name: Ratis
sources: Monaghan, Patricia. The Encyclopedia of Celtic Mythology and Folklore. Checkmark Books, 2008.
text: Ratis is a Continental Celtic goddess. Her name may connect to the word rath, which means a hillfort or settlement. Records describe her as obscure. She guarded such fortified places.

okr.objective: Ratis is a Continental Celtic goddess who guarded hillfort settlements.
